title: Never overwrite a sidecar the editor could not read
notes: Sidecars without version or rating now load with those defaults instead of falling back to an empty recipe. A sidecar that still cannot be parsed (truncated, mistyped fields, not UTF-8) loads as defaults for display only: its bytes are remembered and every sidecar writer refuses to replace them, with a logged warning and a visible save error, until the file changes. Blank files remain ordinary defaults.
